name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Fixed the settings page (and the client badge script) potentially serving a stale cached copy after an upgrade: both were served with no caching headers at all, which left it up to each browser's own guess whether to re-fetch on a revisit - now both are sent with an explicit no-store, so a plugin update always shows up the next time the page loads, no hard-refresh needed. This is very likely why the Downloads section added last release wasn't showing up for some admins even though the feature itself was working.

The Downloads section's progress bar now uses the active theme's own accent color (falling back to Jellyfin's default teal if a theme doesn't define one) instead of a fixed color, so it matches whatever theme is selected rather than always looking the same regardless of it.

196 tests (unchanged).
